title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Data Platform Engineer

£73,000 - £84,000

Newcastle (2 days a week in office)

This is an opportunity to join a well-established international organisation investing heavily in its enterprise data capabilities. You will play a key role in maintaining and evolving a modern cloud-based data platform built on Microsoft Azure technologies, ensuring it remains secure, reliable, and ready to support business-critical data initiatives.

THE COMPANY

They are a globally recognised professional services organisation with a large international footprint and a strong focus on innovation and technology. Their data platform underpins strategic decision-making across multiple business functions and regions. With significant investment in cloud, data, and engineering capabilities, they are building a robust, scalable environment that supports long-term growth. They foster a collaborative culture where technical expertise, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing are highly valued.

THE ROLE

As a Data Platform Engineer, you will take ownership of the operational health and reliability of a modern Azure-based data platform.

Specifically, you can expect to be involved in the following:

  • Providing L2/L3 support across Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and associated Azure services
  • Monitoring platform performance, availability, resilience, and utilisation
  • Investigating and resolving incidents, problems, and service requests through established ITSM processes
  • Supporting major incident response and root cause analysis activities
  • Managing platform administration, operational checks, and environment maintenance
  • Supporting change, release, and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines
  • Maintaining monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and observability solutions
  • Ensuring platform changes meet operational readiness and governance requirements before release
  • Collaborating with architecture, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders
  • Developing runbooks, technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles
  • Supporting governance, security, compliance, and access control activities
  • Driving continuous improvement across platform operations and support processes

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

The successful Data Platform Engineer will have the following skills and experience:

  • Strong commercial experience supporting cloud-based data platforms in production environments
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, or similar modern data platform technologies
  • Strong understanding of Azure services including Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Entra ID, and secure networking concepts
  • Experience managing incidents, problems, changes, and releases within an ITSM framework
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar service management tools
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, diagnostics, and operational reporting
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and release automation
  • Working knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
  • Understanding of data governance, security controls, audit requirements, and compliance within regulated environments
  • Ability to produce high-quality technical documentation and operational procedures

BENEFITS

The successful Data Platform Engineer will receive the following benefits:

  • Salary between £70,000 - £90,000 - depending on experience

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your resume to Majid Latif via the Apply link on this page.
